briefing:
# Zepto Meeting Briefing: 17 November 2026

**Prepared:** 15 November 2026
**Scope:** Developments from approximately 16 October to 15 November 2026, with earlier context where needed for interpretation.

## Purpose and Scope

This briefing prepares the team for the 17 November 2026 meeting with Zepto. It covers what changed in the last 30 days across news, launches, hires, and deals, places those changes against the company's financial and IPO background, and closes with three open questions. Sources are prioritised by reliability: regulatory filings and wire reports first, followed by established business media, then secondary aggregators. Where sources conflict, the conflict is noted.

**Evidence limitation:** The available material contains no verified Zepto hiring announcements and no product launches within the 30-day window. These gaps are reported as findings rather than filled with assumptions.

## Executive Summary

- **The IPO has slipped again.** Zepto now plans to list between February and May 2027, according to remarks by co-founder and CEO Aadit Palicha at an employee town hall ([Inc42, n.d.](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/zepto-stalls-ipo-weekly-funding-rundown-shadowfaxs-fy27-outlook-8yrnc)). This follows a July 2026 target that was reported in May ([Economic Times, 2026](http://hospitality.economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/operations/technology/zepto-plans-to-float-rs-11000-cr-ipo-in-july-2026/131255022)).
- **A pre-IPO round is planned.** Zepto intends to raise a $105 million pre-IPO round from domestic and overseas investors, while curtailing burn and optimising dark stores ([Inc42, n.d.](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/zepto-stalls-ipo-weekly-funding-rundown-shadowfaxs-fy27-outlook-8yrnc)).
- **Regulatory clearance remains valid.** SEBI's clearance is expected to stay valid until November 2027 ([Inc42, n.d.](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/zepto-stalls-ipo-weekly-funding-rundown-shadowfaxs-fy27-outlook-8yrnc)).
- **Unit economics remain the central issue.** FY26 revenue more than doubled, but losses widened to ₹5,905 crore ([Precize, 2026](https://www.precize.in/blogs/zepto-ipo-pre-ipo-share-price)).

## Company Snapshot

| Attribute | Detail | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Business | Quick-commerce grocery and essentials delivery in under 10 minutes via dark stores | [Precize, 2026](https://www.precize.in/blogs/zepto-ipo-pre-ipo-share-price) |
| Founders | Aadit Palicha (MD and CEO), Kaivalya Vohra (Whole-time Director) | [Yahoo Finance / Retail Insight Network, 2026](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/quick-commerce-company-zepto-targets-094837090.html) |
| Corporate status | Converted to a public limited company in December 2025 | [Moneycontrol, 2025](https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/startup/zepto-converts-to-a-public-company-ahead-of-planned-ipo-in-2026-13713491.html) |
| IPO bankers | Axis Capital, Morgan Stanley, Goldman Sachs, Motilal Oswal, HSBC, JM Financial, IIFL Capital | [Reuters via Yahoo Finance, 2026](https://sg.finance.yahoo.com/news/indian-quick-commerce-firm-zepto-204629885.html) |
| Proposed IPO size | Up to $837 million (fresh issue of ₹8,010 crore plus OFS) | [Reuters via Yahoo Finance, 2026](https://sg.finance.yahoo.com/news/indian-quick-commerce-firm-zepto-204629885.html) |

## What Changed in the Last 30 Days

| Date (2026) | Development | Category | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| Mid-Nov (sidebar dated 8–11 Nov) | IPO window moved to February–May 2027 | Deal / Timeline | [Inc42, n.d.](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/zepto-stalls-ipo-weekly-funding-rundown-shadowfaxs-fy27-outlook-8yrnc) |
| Mid-Nov | $105 million pre-IPO round planned | Deal | [Inc42, n.d.](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/zepto-stalls-ipo-weekly-funding-rundown-shadowfaxs-fy27-outlook-8yrnc) |
| 24 Oct | UP Food Safety and Drug Administration suspended licences of four dark stores and warehouses operated by food delivery and quick-commerce platforms | Regulatory | [Wikipedia, 2026](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zepto_(company)) |
| Oct (reported) | Unlisted share price reported to have fallen about 30% from April highs despite SEBI approval | Market signal | [Precize, 2026](https://www.precize.in/blogs/zepto-ipo-pre-ipo-share-price) |
| Oct (status check) | No IPO open date, price band, or listing date announced | Timeline | [Precize, 2026](https://www.precize.in/blogs/zepto-ipo-pre-ipo-share-price) |

### IPO Timeline and Pre-IPO Round

The most material change is the revised listing window. Palicha told employees that Zepto now plans to list between February and May 2027 and will update its DRHP with newer financials ([Inc42, n.d.](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/zepto-stalls-ipo-weekly-funding-rundown-shadowfaxs-fy27-outlook-8yrnc)). This is a clear departure from the July 2026 plan reported by the Economic Times in May 2026 ([Economic Times, 2026](http://hospitality.economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/operations/technology/zepto-plans-to-float-rs-11000-cr-ipo-in-july-2026/131255022)).

The company intends to use the extended clearance window to raise the $105 million pre-IPO round. The stated aims are to curtail burn, optimise dark stores, and align with investors' valuation expectations ([Inc42, n.d.](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/zepto-stalls-ipo-weekly-funding-rundown-shadowfaxs-fy27-outlook-8yrnc)). The reference to aligning valuation expectations suggests that the pre-IPO pricing may differ from earlier marks, though the source does not state a figure.

Earlier reporting on the IPO size and structure remains relevant. The June 2026 updated DRHP included a fresh equity issue of up to Rs80.10 billion and an offer for sale of up to 113.46 million shares, with a possible pre-IPO placement of up to Rs16.02 billion ([Yahoo Finance / Retail Insight Network, 2026](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/quick-commerce-company-zepto-targets-094837090.html)). Any pre-IPO proceeds would be deducted from the fresh issue size, according to the same report ([Yahoo Finance / Retail Insight Network, 2026](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/quick-commerce-company-zepto-targets-094837090.html)). This means the $105 million round may affect the eventual fresh issue.

### Regulatory and Compliance Developments

On 24 October 2026, the Uttar Pradesh Food Safety and Drug Administration suspended licences for four dark stores and warehouses operated by food delivery and quick-commerce platforms after state inspections found non-compliance with food safety standards ([Wikipedia, 2026](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zepto_(company))). The sources reviewed do not name Zepto as one of the affected operators, so the team should confirm whether any Zepto facilities were involved.

Two other matters are older but still open:

- **Enforcement Directorate inquiry:** The ED summoned founders Palicha and Vohra in April 2026, seeking information on foreign investments, shareholding, and income tax returns. The company said it complied and had received no further communication as of the June filing ([Reuters via Yahoo Finance, 2026](https://sg.finance.yahoo.com/news/indian-quick-commerce-firm-zepto-204629885.html)).
- **Municipal waste fine:** The Bengaluru East City Corporation fined Zepto ₹5,000 on 12 October 2026 for failing to follow solid waste segregation rules, a penalty that falls just outside the 30-day window ([Wikipedia, 2026](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zepto_(company))).

### Launches, Hires, and Deals

- **Launches:** No new product or service launches were identified in the window. The Zepto Nova "Pitch in 10" programme, run with Startup India and DPIIT, had a registration deadline of 22 May 2026 and an application result date of 31 July 2026. It is now closed ([Startup Grants India, 2026](https://www.startupgrantsindia.com/competitions/zepto-nova-pitch-in-10-programme)).
- **Hires:** No senior hires or departures were identified in the sources.
- **Deals:** The planned $105 million pre-IPO round is the only deal activity identified. Zepto was not named in the weekly funding rundown's top deals for the week reviewed ([Inc42, n.d.](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/zepto-stalls-ipo-weekly-funding-rundown-shadowfaxs-fy27-outlook-8yrnc)).

## Financial Context

### FY26 Performance

| Metric | FY26 Figure | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Revenue | ₹22,624 crore (₹226.24 billion), more than doubled | [Reuters via Yahoo Finance, 2026](https://sg.finance.yahoo.com/news/indian-quick-commerce-firm-zepto-204629885.html) |
| Net loss | ₹5,905 crore (₹59.05 billion), up from ₹4,700 crore | [Reuters via Yahoo Finance, 2026](https://sg.finance.yahoo.com/news/indian-quick-commerce-firm-zepto-204629885.html) |
| Loss as share of revenue | About 26% | Calculated from the figures above |
| Order volume CAGR (FY24–FY26) | About 119.5% | [Yahoo Finance / Retail Insight Network, 2026](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/quick-commerce-company-zepto-targets-094837090.html) |
| Cash and equivalents | About ₹56.8 billion | [Amquest Education, 2026](https://amquesteducation.com/research/zepto-ipo) |
| Annual cash burn | About ₹35 billion | [Amquest Education, 2026](https://amquesteducation.com/research/zepto-ipo) |

At the Reuters exchange rate of about ₹95.7 per dollar ([Reuters via Yahoo Finance, 2026](https://sg.finance.yahoo.com/news/indian-quick-commerce-firm-zepto-204629885.html)), the FY26 net loss is roughly $617 million. The company loses about a quarter of each rupee of revenue. On cash alone, the balance covers roughly 1.6 years of current burn, before the fresh issue or the pre-IPO round (calculated from the figures above).

Amquest notes that Blinkit, which is listed through Zomato, is at breakeven. It also identifies a gap of about ₹76 per order between Zepto and Blinkit that Zepto would need to close ([Amquest Education, 2026](https://amquesteducation.com/research/zepto-ipo)).

### Valuation Reference Points

Valuation figures vary across sources and should be reconciled before the meeting:

- Zepto raised $450 million at about $7 billion in October 2025 ([Reuters via Yahoo Finance, 2026](https://sg.finance.yahoo.com/news/indian-quick-commerce-firm-zepto-204629885.html)).
- Precize describes the $7 billion valuation as a feature of early 2026 fundraising ([Precize, 2026](https://www.precize.in/blogs/zepto-ipo-pre-ipo-share-price)).
- The DRHP discloses a weighted-average price of ₹37.74 per share for the Series H rounds of October–November 2025. On about 12.60 billion fully diluted shares, Amquest calculates an implied equity value of roughly $5.6 billion ([Amquest Education, 2026](https://amquesteducation.com/research/zepto-ipo)).
- Dhan reported a target valuation of $7–8 billion for the IPO in January 2026 ([Dhan, 2026](https://dhan.co/blog/news/zepto-ipo-update-2026)).

The gap between the $5.6 billion prospectus-implied value and the $7–8 billion press-reported range is material to any IPO pricing discussion.

## Key Risks

1. **Unit economics and profitability.** Losses widened while revenue grew, and public investors are likely to focus on whether losses are narrowing per order ([Precize, 2026](https://www.precize.in/blogs/zepto-ipo-pre-ipo-share-price); [Amquest Education, 2026](https://amquesteducation.com/research/zepto-ipo)).
2. **Competitive pressure.** Blinkit and Swiggy Instamart are backed by listed parents with deeper balance sheets ([Precize, 2026](https://www.precize.in/blogs/zepto-ipo-pre-ipo-share-price)).
3. **Valuation pressure.** The 30% fall in unlisted share prices after approval suggests secondary-market scepticism ([Precize, 2026](https://www.precize.in/blogs/zepto-ipo-pre-ipo-share-price)).
4. **Regulatory exposure.** The ED inquiry, the licence suspensions affecting platforms in Uttar Pradesh, and municipal penalties add operational and compliance risk ([Reuters via Yahoo Finance, 2026](https://sg.finance.yahoo.com/news/indian-quick-commerce-firm-zepto-204629885.html); [Wikipedia, 2026](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zepto_(company))).
5. **Dark-store capital intensity.** About ₹1,629 crore of the fresh issue is earmarked for roughly 1,904 new dark stores, an average of about ₹86 lakh per store if spread evenly. The actual allocation per store is not disclosed in the sources ([Precize, 2026](https://www.precize.in/blogs/zepto-ipo-pre-ipo-share-price)).

## Analyst Assessment

In my judgement, the revised timeline is more likely a reflection of weak public-market readiness than a purely procedural delay. Three signals support this view. First, the company is raising a pre-IPO round to align with investor valuation expectations, which implies a pricing gap. Second, the company is also pursuing burn reduction and dark-store optimisation, suggesting that the cost base is being reset ahead of listing. Third, the company is extending its clearance window rather than pressing for a near-term launch.

The strongest positive case rests on growth: order volumes compounded at about 119.5% over two years, and revenue more than doubled in FY26 ([Yahoo Finance / Retail Insight Network, 2026](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/quick-commerce-company-zepto-targets-094837090.html)). The strongest negative case rests on losses, which widened in absolute terms and still represent roughly a quarter of revenue ([Reuters via Yahoo Finance, 2026](https://sg.finance.yahoo.com/news/indian-quick-commerce-firm-zepto-204629885.html)). My view is that the February–May 2027 window is achievable only if Zepto shows visible progress on per-order losses in the next two quarters. Without that, further delay or a lower valuation is more likely than an IPO at the earlier $7–8 billion ambition.

This assessment rests largely on press reports and secondary aggregators rather than primary company disclosures for the most recent period. It should be tested against management's own data in the meeting.

## Three Open Questions for the Meeting

1. **Valuation and unit economics:** What valuation range is management targeting for the $105 million pre-IPO round, and what adjusted EBITDA per order or contribution margin milestones must be met before the updated DRHP is filed?
2. **Burn and dark-store plan:** Which dark-store cohorts are being optimised or closed under the burn-reduction programme, and what is the target monthly burn and runway through the IPO window?
3. **Regulatory status:** Has the Enforcement Directorate inquiry progressed since the June filing, and were any Zepto facilities affected by the October 2026 licence suspensions in Uttar Pradesh?
